00_standing.jpg: the surgeon stands upright, neck inside the collar
01_squat_transition.jpg: half way down: heels on the floor, sleeves clear of the knees
02_squat_front.jpg: deep squat from the front: knees open out, torso leans forward, heels down
03_squat_side.jpg: deep squat from the side: hips below the knees, head forward of the hips, sleeves clear
04_recovered.jpg: back up from the squat, standing as at the start
05_looking_down_back.jpg: looking fully down, from behind: the head turns about the top of the neck, the neck stays in the collar
06_looking_up_side.jpg: looking fully up, from the side: the neck stays in the collar, no gap at the throat
07_walking_stride.jpg: mid stride: one foot planted, legs their full length, no knee bent backward
